tools.name: workspace_list
tools.description: List files and directories in the project currently open in FrustIDE.
tools.usage: Use before assuming the project layout or choosing a file to inspect.

path.description: Path relative to the open project.

tools.name: workspace_read
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 project file with line numbers and optional line bounds.
tools.usage: Read specifications and surrounding source before proposing or making an edit.

path.description: Path relative to the open project.

tools.name: workspace_search
tools.description: Search UTF-8 text files in the open project and return matching paths, lines, and excerpts.
tools.usage: Use to find definitions, references, requirements, and relevant documentation before editing.

path.description: Path relative to the open project.

tools.name: registry_search
tools.description: List or search the public Frate pod registry and return published pod metadata and exports.
tools.usage: Use before inventing a dependency or asking the user which pods exist. An empty query lists all published pods; a query filters pod names by substring.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive pod-name substring. Empty lists all pods.

tools.name: workspace_create_directory
tools.description: Create a directory inside the project currently open in FrustIDE, including missing parents.
tools.usage: Use to establish a requested project or module layout. It succeeds when the directory already exists.

path.description: Path relative to the open project.

tools.name: workspace_create_file
tools.description: Create a new UTF-8 source, specification, or documentation file without overwriting an existing file.
tools.usage: Use for new files. If the file exists, read it and make a focused edit instead.

path.description: Path relative to the open project.

tools.name: workspace_write_file
tools.description: Rewrite the complete contents of an existing UTF-8 project file using an optimistic revision check.
tools.usage: Use after reading the file when a full-file repair is safer than a sequence of exact replacements. Pass the SHA-256 value returned by workspace_read; the write is rejected if the file changed afterward.

path.description: Path relative to the open project.

expected_sha256.description: SHA-256 revision returned by the most recent workspace_read of this file.

tools.name: workspace_replace_text
tools.description: Replace exact text in an existing UTF-8 project file.
tools.usage: Use for focused edits after reading the file. By default the old text must occur exactly once.

path.description: Path relative to the open project.

tools.name: workspace_check_frust
tools.description: Compile-check a Frust source file directly from project content and return structured compiler diagnostics without creating temporary files.
tools.usage: Use after editing Frust code. Fix reported errors and repeat until the check passes before completing the task.

path.description: Frust source path relative to the open project.
